entities.summary: Johann Anastasius Freylinghausen was a theologian associated with the Pietist Halle School and a scholar and follower of August Hermann Francke. He was the second director of the Franckeschen Stiftungen, a collection of schools for orphans. Johann Anastasius Freylinghausen was a writers & intellectuals from Bad Gandersheim (1670-12-02, Bad Gandersheim–1739-02-12).
